prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied pagoda sprite. Preserve its beautiful red-and-white Japanese architecture, four tiers, charcoal tile roofs, red balcony rails, gold bells, long ringed finial, orthographic isometric camera, crisp pixel detail and transparent background. The lowest foundation should be a generous stone platform around the building. Preserve the open doorway and short stone stairs on the right-facing facade, centered on that facade, leading toward the bottom-right. Keep the finial and upper two tiers unchanged in scale and detail; do not shorten the building. Keep the whole object comfortably inside the canvas, no clipping. Some small bells hang freely below the outer eave corners with transparent space around them. No background scenery, no additional ground island, no people, no trees, no text, no cast shadow blob. Actual transparent background.

Preserve the new generous broad stone base and stairs, the wide bottom storey, the red railings, all materials, lighting, pixel-art style, and isometric camera. Upper storeys progressively narrow upward. Keep the whole pagoda within generous transparent margins; extend the canvas vertically if necessary. Transparent background. No environment, no ground island, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the wider foundation. Return image 1 with all its FOUR roof tiers intact, its same height, same upper finial and same details. The only edit is to broaden the BOTTOM ONE storey and stone terrace to match the generous wide base seen in image 2. Do not copy image 2's three-storey structure. Do not remove or combine any of image 1's four storeys. Number the visible roofs mentally from the top: roof 1 unchanged, roof 2 unchanged, roof 3 unchanged, roof 4 widened along with the room and terrace below it. The output is the four-storey tower from image 1, with a wider bottom storey and foundation. Keep the open right-facing entrance and steps, retain small hanging bells under the eaves. Same isometric pixel art and transparent background. No text or labels.
review: Selected the broad terrace and lower-storey artwork. The generated result has three roof tiers despite the four-tier preservation request; this does not affect the requested wider-base behavior.
